Changes.note: Signing in opens a session with your Medaris account in this browser; Tedris, Nazar and Nizam share it. It closes after 5 hours without activity, or 14 days with “Remember me”; “Sign out” closes it at once. The verification link marks your e-mail address as verified. What you save on “Complete your profile” (gender, first and last name, e-mail, the privacy notice box) is written to your account, and the portals and tedrisat read it from there; you can change your gender later on the Account page in Tedris.
